content:
I did manage to get this in reverse mode, but the name of the clash was a big hint. I'm pretty sure that the name won't appear for players, so I think it would be better if the stub generator's write statement was "standing dominoes" or something similar.

Goal
 - The '.' in "Each . is an empty cell" should be formatted  as a constant {{}}. I believe the '1' in "every cell from [[i]] + 1" should also be a constant. Doesn't hurt to do the same for the constraints as well.

Cases
 - They seem good to me, but there's a lot of 1s, 2s and 3s and no 6,7 or 8. There is also no validator in which there are two or more 1s next to each other.
 - I think that a case pair where the first character is a '.' would be good. Remember to remove that constraint if you choose to make that change.

The points raised by @Sflubaduba are all very good. I'd like to add a few points:

Goal
* Please format the example input "2.1..3.1" and all numbers in its explanation as {{constants}}.

Cases
* Validator 2: Please modify the input so that it consists entirely of 1s.

* Test 3: Please modify the input to include the digits 1, 2 and 4.

* Test 5, Validator 5, Test 7: Please modify the inputs so that they don't end with 1 or 2.

* More generally, the goal is to have a variety of cases that start and end with different digits, while keeping each test and its corresponding validator similar.

* Please ensure that the digits 6, 7 and 8 appear in some tests.

* Please ensure that the digits 5, 6, 7 and 8 appear in some validators.

* In addition to creating new cases whose inputs start with ".", consider adding and/or modifying cases so that their inputs end with one or more ".". Across the new or modified pairs, the number of trailing "." should be

  • less than the height of the final domino in some pairs,
  • equal to that height in others, and
  • greater than that height in the remaining pairs.

* Please create a final pair of cases where the input at least 90 characters long, contains all digits from 1 to 9, and produces an output between 10 and 30.

Thanks.
